name: Dark Barrier extends Stoicism by 5 s and raises its effectiveness by 25% (#1346)
contract: Dark Barrier 705520 reads 'Increases the duration of Stoicism by $/1000;s1 sec and increases its effectiveness by $s2%.' In the installed Spell.dbc (server DBC 2026-09-17; the older dbc_clientset copy has only the duration effect) it is passive, family 21, effect 0 = SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER misc 1 = SPELLMOD_DURATION BasePoints 4999 (+5000 ms) and effect 1 = SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER misc 8 = SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS BasePoints 24 (+25%), both with class mask word 1 = 0x02000000, which is Stoicism 804802's flag word. Stoicism has SpellDuration index 31 = 8000 ms and two auras: effect 0 dodge (aura 49) and effect 1 parry (aura 47), BasePoints 29 (DieSides 1, so 30 each). Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies SPELLMOD_DURATION (SpellAuras.cpp:812) so the duration is 13000 ms, and Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers (Unit.cpp:12149) applies ALL_EFFECTS so each amount is 30 * 1.25 = 37.5, truncated to 37 (SpellInfo.cpp:582). The scenario reads the probes before and after learning, then casts Stoicism and reads the real aura.

steps.label: Stoicism lasts 8000 ms without the talent (SpellDuration 31)
Stoicism dodge amount is 30 without the talent
Stoicism parry amount is 30 without the talent
Live duration is at most 13 s and clearly above the 8 s base
